Home & Discover

Open the app and your feed is ready.

  • Category chips at the top — Home, Trending, News, Sports, Gaming and more
  • Recommended For You, Trending Now, Quick picks and recently uploaded videos
  • Endless scrolling that loads more as you go, with a download button and a + (add to playlist) button on every video
  • Categories and singers change with your country, so you see relevant content first
  • Shorts stay in their own Shorts screen and on channel pages — they never clutter your normal video feeds

Video player

A player with the controls you actually need.

  • Choose video quality — if a quality is missing, the closest one is used automatically
  • Playback speed, subtitles / CC and Autoplay
  • Up Next list, chapters and the full description under the video
  • Sleep timer so music and videos stop by themselves
  • Read comments, and post your own after signing in

Shorts

Swipe through short videos in a dedicated screen.

  • Full-screen vertical Shorts you can swipe through
  • Shorts quality adjusts per video so every clip looks sharp
  • Shorts are also available on each channel’s own page
  • Open the sound behind a Short in a proper native screen

Music

Your own music player powered by YouTube.

  • Music tab with charts, new releases and trending songs
  • Singers of your country shown as a scrollable row — tap a singer to play their songs
  • Now Playing screen with lyrics (when available), shuffle and play-all
  • Keeps playing in the background with notification and home-screen widget controls
  • Save songs for offline listening

Downloads

Save what you love and watch or listen without internet.

  • Download videos in the quality you pick — up to 2160P (4K) when the video offers it — or download audio only (M4A, best quality)
  • Download over Wi-Fi only option to protect your mobile data
  • Live progress and notifications while a download runs
  • A Downloads screen with All, Videos and Audio tabs, file size, share and delete, plus Hot Sites and Hot Videos below
  • Everything you download plays offline

Built-in browser & link downloader

Save videos from other apps and websites.

  • Browse the web in tabs with bookmarks and history
  • Hot Sites shortcuts to popular places, and Facebook and Instagram sign-in from Settings
  • Download videos from Instagram, Facebook and X (Twitter) with one tap
  • Share an Instagram, Facebook or X link to StreamX and the download starts automatically
  • Share or paste a YouTube link and StreamX opens it straight in the player

Your library

Everything you watched and follow, in one place.

  • History of watched videos and search history with quick clear
  • Followed channels so you never miss new uploads
  • Playlists — add any video with the + button, play them all or download them together
  • Sign in with your account for your own experience and to comment

Country-based content

StreamX shows what matters where you live.

  • Your country is detected automatically
  • Home categories and Music singers come from a content pack made for your country
  • New categories and singers can be added online — no app update needed
  • Always open a video from anywhere; the country only decides what is suggested first

API

Use the StreamX API in your own site

Free JSON. No API key. Two requests are all you need.

1. Get the category list

Call this once when your page or app starts.

GET https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories/manifest.json

2. Get the videos of a category

GET https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories/<name>.json

Available names: home recently_uploaded indian_pop_music haryanvi punjabi storytelling music gaming news sports fashion bollywood_movies hollywood_movies south_indian_movies punjabi_movies

Video fields

FieldMeaning
titleVideo title
urlYouTube link; the video ID is read from it
thumbnailPreview image
channelChannel name
durationVideo length

How to use it

  1. Fetch manifest.json and show the names as tabs or a menu.
  2. When a category is picked, fetch its .json file and draw the video cards.
  3. On a website, play with the YouTube embed on an HTTPS page. In an Android app, play with ExoPlayer.
  4. To update data, edit the JSON files in your GitHub repo and push. GitHub Pages updates in a few minutes.

Complete working example

index.html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>My Video Site</title>
</head>
<body>
<select id="cat"></select>
<div id="player"></div>
<div id="list"></div>
<script>
const BASE = "https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories/";
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

async function start() {
  const m = await (await fetch(BASE + "manifest.json")).json();
  const cats = m.categories || m.list || [];
  $("cat").innerHTML = cats.map(c => {
    const k = c.file || c.name || c.id;
    return `<option value="${k}">${k}</option>`;
  }).join("");
  $("cat").onchange = () => loadCategory($("cat").value);
  loadCategory($("cat").value);
}

async function loadCategory(key) {
  const file = key.endsWith(".json") ? key : key + ".json";
  const data = await (await fetch(BASE + file)).json();
  const videos = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.videos || data.items || []);
  $("list").innerHTML = "";
  videos.forEach(v => {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.innerHTML = `<img src="${v.thumbnail}" width="160"> ${v.title}`;
    d.onclick = () => play(v);
    $("list").appendChild(d);
  });
}

function play(v) {
  const u = new URL(v.url);
  const id = u.hostname.includes("youtu.be") ? u.pathname.slice(1) : u.searchParams.get("v");
  $("player").innerHTML = `<iframe width="100%" height="315"
    src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1"
    referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>`;
}
start();
</script>
</body>
</html>

main.dart

lib/main.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

const BASE = "https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories";

void main() => runApp(MyApp());

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Streamx',
      theme: ThemeData(primarySwatch: Colors.red),
      home: CategoriesScreen(),
    );
  }
}

class StreamxAPI {
  static Future<List> getCategories() async {
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse("$BASE/manifest.json"));
    final data = jsonDecode(res.body);
    return data["categories"];
  }

  static Future<List> getVideos(String fileName) async {
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse("$BASE/$fileName"));
    return jsonDecode(res.body);
  }
}

class CategoriesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  _CategoriesScreenState createState() => _CategoriesScreenState();
}

class _CategoriesScreenState extends State<CategoriesScreen> {
  List categories = [];
  bool loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final cats = await StreamxAPI.getCategories();
    setState(() {
      categories = cats;
      loading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (loading) return Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text("Streamx")),
      body: ListView.builder(
        itemCount: categories.length,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
          final cat = categories[i];
          return ListTile(
            title: Text(cat["name"]),
            subtitle: Text("${cat["count"]} videos"),
            onTap: () => Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (_) => VideosScreen(file: cat["file"], title: cat["name"]),
            )),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class VideosScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String file;
  final String title;
  VideosScreen({required this.file, required this.title});

  @override
  _VideosScreenState createState() => _VideosScreenState();
}

class _VideosScreenState extends State<VideosScreen> {
  List videos = [];
  bool loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final vids = await StreamxAPI.getVideos(widget.file);
    setState(() {
      videos = vids;
      loading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (loading) return Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
      body: ListView.builder(
        itemCount: videos.length,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
          final v = videos[i];
          return ListTile(
            leading: Image.network(v["thumbnail"], width: 80, fit: BoxFit.cover),
            title: Text(v["title"], maxLines: 2),
            subtitle: Text(v["channel"] ?? ""),
            onTap: () async {
              final url = Uri.parse(v["url"]);
              if (await canLaunchUrl(url)) {
                await launchUrl(url, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              }
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

MainActivity.kt

MainActivity.kt
package com.example.streamx

import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.ListView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.net.URL

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private val BASE = "https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories"
    private lateinit var categoriesList: ListView

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        categoriesList = findViewById(R.id.categoriesList)
        loadCategories()
    }

    private fun loadCategories() {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            try {
                val json = URL("$BASE/manifest.json").readText()
                val data = JSONObject(json)
                val categories = data.getJSONArray("categories")

                val names = ArrayList<String>()
                for (i in 0 until categories.length()) {
                    val cat = categories.getJSONObject(i)
                    names.add("${cat.getString("name")} (${cat.getInt("count")})")
                }

                runOnUiThread {
                    categoriesList.adapter = ArrayAdapter(
                        this@MainActivity,
                        android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
                        names
                    )
                    categoriesList.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, pos, _ ->
                        val cat = categories.getJSONObject(pos)
                        loadVideos(cat.getString("file"))
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadVideos(fileName: String) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            try {
                val json = URL("$BASE/$fileName").readText()
                val videos = JSONArray(json)

                val titles = ArrayList<String>()
                val urls = ArrayList<String>()
                for (i in 0 until videos.length()) {
                    val v = videos.getJSONObject(i)
                    titles.add(v.getString("title"))
                    urls.add(v.getString("url"))
                }

                runOnUiThread {
                    categoriesList.adapter = ArrayAdapter(
                        this@MainActivity,
                        android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
                        titles
                    )
                    categoriesList.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, pos, _ ->
                        playVideo(urls[pos])
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun playVideo(url: String) {
        startActivity(Intent(this, PlayerActivity::class.java).putExtra("url", url))
    }
}

Why Error 153 happens

The YouTube embed refuses to start when the page sends no referrer: the HTML is opened as a local file, or an Android WebView loads it with loadData(). Hosting on HTTPS fixes the web demo. In the app, skip the embed and play with ExoPlayer.

How ExoPlayer plays YouTube

ExoPlayer cannot open a youtube.com/watch link. It needs a direct stream URL, so NewPipeExtractor converts the link first.

1
Add dependencies

Media3 ExoPlayer, NewPipeExtractor, OkHttp, desugaring

2
Resolve the url field

StreamInfo.getInfo() returns video and audio stream URLs

3
Play

Merge video and audio in ExoPlayer, show it in PlayerView

    implementation 'androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.3.1'

NewPipeDownloader.kt

NewPipeDownloader.kt
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import org.schabi.newpipe.extractor.downloader.*

class NewPipeDownloader : Downloader() {
    private val client = OkHttpClient()
    override fun execute(request: Request): Response {
        val body = request.dataToSend()?.toRequestBody()
        val b = okhttp3.Request.Builder().url(request.url()).method(request.httpMethod(), body)
        request.headers().forEach { (k, v) -> b.removeHeader(k); v.forEach { b.addHeader(k, it) } }
        client.newCall(b.build()).execute().use { r ->
            return Response(r.code, r.message, r.headers.toMultimap(), r.body?.string(), r.request.url.toString())
        }
    }
}

PlayerActivity.kt

PlayerActivity.kt
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
import androidx.media3.datasource.DefaultHttpDataSource
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.ExoPlayer
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.MergingMediaSource
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.ProgressiveMediaSource
import androidx.media3.ui.PlayerView
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.schabi.newpipe.extractor.NewPipe
import org.schabi.newpipe.extractor.ServiceList
import org.schabi.newpipe.extractor.stream.StreamInfo

class PlayerActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private var player: ExoPlayer? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val view = PlayerView(this)
        setContentView(view)
        val url = intent.getStringExtra("url") ?: return finish()

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                // 1) Resolve the YouTube link into direct stream URLs (off the main thread)
                val (video, audio) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    NewPipe.init(NewPipeDownloader())
                    val info = StreamInfo.getInfo(ServiceList.YouTube, url)
                    // Best HD: video-only + audio, merged. Simple option: info.videoStreams (up to 720p, has audio)
                    val v = info.videoOnlyStreams.maxByOrNull { it.height }
                    val a = info.audioStreams.maxByOrNull { it.averageBitrate }
                    if (v != null && a != null) v.content to a.content
                    else info.videoStreams.maxByOrNull { it.height }!!.content to null
                }
                // 2) Build the ExoPlayer media source
                val factory = DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory().setUserAgent("Mozilla/5.0")
                val vSrc = ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(factory).createMediaSource(MediaItem.fromUri(video))
                val source = if (audio != null)
                    MergingMediaSource(vSrc, ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(factory).createMediaSource(MediaItem.fromUri(audio)))
                else vSrc
                // 3) Play
                player = ExoPlayer.Builder(this@PlayerActivity).build().also {
                    view.player = it
                    it.setMediaSource(source)
                    it.prepare()
                    it.playWhenReady = true
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Toast.makeText(this@PlayerActivity, "Could not play: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() { player?.release(); super.onDestroy() }
}

Play from this web page with ExoPlayer

A browser cannot run ExoPlayer. But when this page is opened inside your app's WebView, tapping a video calls the app and ExoPlayer plays it. In a normal browser the page falls back to the YouTube embed.

WebActivity.kt
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
import android.webkit.WebView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

class WebActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val web = WebView(this)
        setContentView(web)
        web.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        web.settings.domStorageEnabled = true
        // The page calls AndroidPlayer.play(url) -> ExoPlayer opens
        web.addJavascriptInterface(object {
            @JavascriptInterface
            fun play(url: String) {
                startActivity(Intent(this@WebActivity, PlayerActivity::class.java).putExtra("url", url))
            }
        }, "AndroidPlayer")
        web.loadUrl("https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/StreamX_API_v2.html")
    }
}

Add <activity android:name=".PlayerActivity" /> to AndroidManifest.xml. Stream URLs expire after a few hours, so resolve on every play. If your project already has these libraries, keep your versions; on older NewPipeExtractor, content is url.

    .video img { width: 120px; height: 68px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 5px; }
    .video-info { flex: 1; }
    .video-info b { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .video-info small { color: #aaa; }
    .back { background: #333; padding: 10px 15px; margin-bottom: 10px;
            border: none; color: white; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 5px; }
    .loader { text-align: center; padding: 30px; color: #aaa; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>Streamx</header>
  <div class="container" id="app">
    <div class="loader">Loading...</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const BASE = "https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories";
    const app = document.getElementById("app");

    async function loadCategories() {
      app.innerHTML = '<div class="loader">Loading categories...</div>';
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/manifest.json`);
        const data = await res.json();
        app.innerHTML = "";
        data.categories.forEach(cat => {
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.className = "category";
          div.innerHTML = `<span><b>${cat.name}</b></span><span>${cat.count} videos</span>`;
          div.onclick = () => loadVideos(cat.file, cat.name);
          app.appendChild(div);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        app.innerHTML = `<div class="loader">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
      }
    }

    async function loadVideos(fileName, title) {
      app.innerHTML = '<div class="loader">Loading videos...</div>';
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/${fileName}`);
        const videos = await res.json();
        app.innerHTML = `<button class="back" onclick="loadCategories()">&larr; Back</button>`;
        videos.forEach(v => {
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.className = "video";
          div.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${v.thumbnail}" loading="lazy">
            <div class="video-info">
              <b>${v.title}</b>
              <small>${v.channel || ""}</small>
            </div>
          `;
          div.onclick = () => { window.open(v.url, "_blank"); };
          app.appendChild(div);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        app.innerHTML = `<div class="loader">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
      }
    }

    loadCategories();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

App.js

App.js
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, FlatList, Image, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, Linking, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';

const BASE = "https://zk5740764-cmyk.github.io/Streamx-/categories";

export default function App() {
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState([]);
  const [currentFile, setCurrentFile] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`${BASE}/manifest.json`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        setCategories(data.categories);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, []);

  const loadVideos = (fileName) => {
    setLoading(true);
    fetch(`${BASE}/${fileName}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        setVideos(data);
        setCurrentFile(fileName);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  };

  if (loading) return <ActivityIndicator size="large" style={{ flex: 1 }} />;

  if (currentFile) {
    return (
      <View style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10 }}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { setCurrentFile(null); setVideos([]); }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 10 }}>&larr; Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <FlatList
          data={videos}
          keyExtractor={item => item.id}
          renderItem={({ item }) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => Linking.openURL(item.url)}
              style={styles.video}
            >
              <Image source={{ uri: item.thumbnail }} style={styles.thumb} />
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text numberOfLines={2}>{item.title}</Text>
                <Text style={{ color: '#888' }}>{item.channel}</Text>
              </View>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={categories}
      keyExtractor={item => item.name}
      renderItem={({ item }) => (
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => loadVideos(item.file)} style={styles.cat}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>{item.name}</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: '#888' }}>{item.count} videos</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      )}
    />
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  cat: { padding: 20, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderColor: '#eee' },
  video: { flexDirection: 'row', padding: 10, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderColor: '#eee' },
  thumb: { width: 120, height: 68, marginRight: 10, borderRadius: 5 }
});

Questions

Is StreamX free?

Yes. The APK on this page is free to download.

Why is it not on the Play Store?

StreamX is distributed directly as an APK, so Android asks you to allow installation from your browser once.

Which Android version do I need?

Android 7.0 (Nougat) or newer.

How do I update?

When a new version is ready StreamX shows an update message with a one-tap Update Now button. You can also download the latest APK from this page and install it over the old one.

Is it safe?

Only download StreamX from the official links on this website or the GitHub releases page. Do not install copies from unknown sources.

How do I change the language?

Open Settings → Advanced → General → App Language and pick from 56 languages.

Can I download from Instagram, Facebook and X?

Yes. Use the built-in browser or share the link to StreamX and the download starts.

I found a bug or want a feature

Message us on Instagram or in the Facebook group — feedback shapes every update.

About StreamX & the community

The idea

StreamX started with a simple goal: a fast, friendly Android app where videos, music, Shorts and downloads live together. It is built by SoulReaper8, an independent Android developer, and grows with every update.

The app follows you: it detects your country to suggest what people around you enjoy, speaks your language and lets you save content for offline use.
